# grok-export-tool

> Export your complete **Grok Bot** and regular **Grok chat** data from [grok.com](https://grok.com) — every conversation plus multimodal attachments (images, videos, files) — into an Agent-friendly format, with a lightweight MCP server and a standard Agent Skill so AI assistants can query the context directly.

## Overview

This repository provides:

- **`grok-bot-export.py`** — exports every Grok Bot (roster + full transcript) and regular Grok chats, and downloads multimodal attachments in parallel. Modes: `--mode bot|chat|all`.
- **`grok-bot-mcp.py`** — a lightweight, zero-dependency stdio MCP server exposing `list_bots`, `get_bot`, and `search`.
- **`.claude/skills/grok-export/`** — an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io)-standard skill (SKILL.md), supported by 27+ agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, …).

## Key properties

- Fully local: no browser extension, no re-login, no API key.
- Cross-platform: macOS (Keychain) / Windows (DPAPI) / Linux, plus a `--cookie` fallback.
- Not affected by message quota: reads history over grok.com's internal WebSocket API using the cookies of an already-logged-in Chrome.
- Agent-friendly output: normalized `messages.jsonl` (one JSON per line), readable `conversation.md`, raw `transcript.json`, and downloaded attachments.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Grok Bots (default): full export (messages + attachments)
python3 grok-bot-export.py

# Messages only (~20 s)
python3 grok-bot-export.py --messages-only

# Regular Grok chats
python3 grok-bot-export.py --mode chat
```

## Disclaimer

Unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by xAI. Relies on reverse-engineered internal endpoints that may change without notice. Use it only to back up your own account data and respect grok.com's Terms of Service.
